# Region Filter

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Keep rows inside, outside or near a polygon. Runs in SQL, on the GPU or the CPU, wherever the planner puts it.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "region", "name": "region", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:metres`, or read elsewhere as `ch('region/metres')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `mode` | `menu` | `"inside"` | `inside`, `outside`, `near` |
| `geometry` | `code` | `"POLYGON((-74.02 40.70, -73.97 40.71, -73.97 40.76, -74.01 40.76, -74.02 40.70))"` |  |
| `metres` | `float` | `500` |  |
| `lng` | `expr` | `"lng"` |  |
| `lat` | `expr` | `"lat"` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
